parameters.query: INSERT INTO jarvis_ops.tech_event (trace_id, run_id, workflow_name, node_name, context_id, object_kind, object_id, tool_id, adapter_id, status_code, error_class, message_safe, duration_ms) SELECT r.trace_id, r.run_id, r.workflow_name, r.node_name, r.context_id, r.object_kind, r.object_id, r.tool_id, r.adapter_id, r.status_code, r.error_class, r.message_safe, r.duration_ms FROM jsonb_to_record(convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb) AS r(trace_id text, run_id text, workflow_name text, node_name text, context_id text, object_kind text, object_id text, tool_id text, adapter_id text, status_code integer, error_class text, message_safe varchar(500), duration_ms integer) RETURNING tech_event_id

INSERT INTO jarvis_ops.tech_event (trace_id, run_id, workflow_name, node_name, context_id, object_kind, object_id, tool_id, adapter_id, status_code, error_class, message_safe, duration_ms) SELECT r.trace_id, r.run_id, r.workflow_name, r.node_name, r.context_id, r.object_kind, r.object_id, r.tool_id, r.adapter_id, r.status_code, r.error_class, r.message_safe, r.duration_ms FROM jsonb_to_record(convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb) AS r(trace_id text, run_id text, workflow_name text, node_name text, context_id text, object_kind text, object_id text, tool_id text, adapter_id text, status_code integer, error_class text, message_safe varchar(500), duration_ms integer) RETURNING tech_event_id

parameters.content:
## Credential-Bedarf

Beide Postgres-Nodes schreiben nach jarvis_ops.tech_event, jeweils unter der Rolle des eigenen Kontexts:

- tech_event schreiben als jv_privat_user  ->  jv_privat_postgres
- tech_event schreiben als jv_visolva_user ->  jv_visolva_postgres

Beide Datenbankrollen existieren, sind aber NOLOGIN und ohne Kennwort.

Vor der Aktivierung:
1. Anmelderecht und Kennwort ausserhalb des Repositoriums setzen
2. Credential in n8n unter genau diesem Namen anlegen
3. Credential am jeweiligen Node zuordnen

In tech_event gehoeren keine Fachinhalte. message_safe wird vorher bereinigt und auf 500 Zeichen gekuerzt.
